description: This file contains the implementation of the PoissonDistribution class, which models the Poisson probability distribution, including methods for calculating probabilities, cumulative probabilities, and sampling from the distribution.

classes.name: PoissonDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the Poisson distribution, providing probability calculations and sampling functionalities.

methods.name: getMean
methods.description: Returns the mean (expected value) of the distribution.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability of observing exactly x events.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the probability mass function at x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative probability up to x.

methods.name: normalApproximateProbability
methods.description: Approximates the probability using a normal distribution with mean and variance equal to the Poisson mean.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the numerical mean of the distribution, identical to getMean.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution, equal to the mean.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support (always 0).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (positive infinity approximated by Integer.MAX_VALUE).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support is connected (always true).

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the distribution.

methods.name: nextPoisson
methods.description: Internal method for generating a Poisson-distributed random number, used in sampling.
